# Dramatis Personae

## Personae Brydainiae

### Arthur Cadwallader
An aspiring knight of 20 years, seeking martial glory for his scholarly family. Sworn to be Hen Sarum's man.

#### his father Emrys Cadwallader
a bookish recluse, Earl of Porthennor

#### his older brothers Emrys, Carwyn, Bryn
a scholar, a merchant, and a wastrel

#### his elder sister Ceridwen
the wife of Rhodri Gwinwr 7th Earl of Wyth

#### his younger sister Mali
a shy nun with an interest in the mystic

#### his tutor Sir Aled Morglawydd
Master of Arms and veteran of The Long War

#### his uncle Sir Huw Tresco
a wise and kind knight

#### Sergeant Petroc, Tom, Tom, Lorcan, Goch
the garrison of Porthennor, true local men

and Arthur's retainers

#### his squire Owen Tresco
his cousin, well meaning and unassuming

#### Petroc Bryher
a hardened sailor

#### Merlin Merrick
a boy of 12

#### his page Dogmael Porthennor
a beloved orphan

#### his ship's cat Bryn Ddu
adopted as his personal blazon

### Owain ap Ieuan Gradawc
Knight of the Veil. The proud Earl of Hen Sarum. Even handed and level headed.

#### his wife Myfanwy ferch Gwilym Dyrh
a dutiful and shrewd woman

#### his eldest son Gwilym
the august castellan of Hen Sarum

#### his younger sons Hywel, and Cai
infants of 10 and 5 years

#### his elder daughter Agnes "Nest" ferch Owain
wife of Christopher Fitzalan heir to the Duchy of Waerick

#### his younger daughter Mari ferch Owain
an exemplar of etiquette

### Margon Flynn
Baron of Treftone. Died of misadventure at the tournament of Northome.

#### his son Tomos Flynn
failed to avenge his father's honour, scorned

#### his widow Mary Torstall
sister of a deceased Baron, widow of another

### Llewellyn ap Owain o'r Gaer
Earl of Aberiska, elderly and stump handed. Pacifier of Treftone's rebellion.

#### his son Owain ap Llewellyn o'r Gaer
a capable knight and good fellow

### Caradog Conway
Earl of Cynwy, a grizzled elder.

### Gruffudd Sant-Ioan
Duke of Brycheiniog and Constable of Albion. A fiercely proud man, true to his countrymen.
